dedupe_keys.name: listado de cooperativas de agua potable

description: Listado de Cooperativas de Agua Potable is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Subsecretaría de Economía y Empresas de Menor Tamaño. Contiene datos recopiladospor el Departamento de Cooperativas del Ministerio de Economía, Fomento y Turismo, relativos a las cooperativas del rubro agua potable, indicando su nombre, región en la que están ubicadas, situación y estado actual en que se encuentran. Coverage: Chile. The portal files it under the publisher Subsecretaría de Economía y Empresas de Menor Tamaño. Its tags are recursos. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2015-11-17 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Non-Commercial (Any). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
